data.name: Alice
data.message: Finishing scan now, Diana can see me.

I found Eve’s body in medbay and reported immediately. My route was navigation -> storage -> medbay. I saw Diana in storage around tick 7, and she had just entered storage from the medbay direction. Then I went into medbay and found Eve dead there. I didn’t see anyone else nearby. Diana should explain her path because she was coming from where the body was.

I was up around oxygen/upper engine most of the round, then came down into medbay around tick 6. I saw Alice leaving medbay toward electrical, and Eve came into medbay from electrical right after that. I didn’t see the kill happen, but Eve was definitely alive when I saw her enter medbay. 

Bob’s info about Diana coming from the medbay direction into storage is important, but Alice was also right there in that medbay/electrical doorway timing. So I think the likely window is after Eve entered medbay, and the people near that area were Alice/Diana, maybe Bob arriving after. I’d like to hear Diana and Alice explain exactly where they went after that.

My route was electrical -> medbay -> storage. I was in medbay with Alice around ticks 3 through 5; I saw Alice enter medbay from storage at tick 3 and she stayed there while I was there. I then went down to storage. I did not see Eve at all, and I didn’t see a body.

In storage, I saw Bob leave storage toward medbay at tick 7. Then at tick 9, I saw Frank enter storage from the medbay direction. So Frank was definitely coming out of the same area where Bob found Eve. That lines up with Frank saying he was in medbay, but it also means he had opportunity after seeing Eve alive. Alice was also in medbay earlier, but from what I saw, Frank was the most recent person coming from medbay right before the report.

I was nowhere near medbay for this. My route was upper engine -> oxygen -> upper engine -> lower engine. The only person I saw was Frank in oxygen around tick 3, so I can confirm he started up north like he said, but I can’t clear him for after that because he could’ve gotten to medbay by tick 6.

From the stories, the kill seems centered around medbay after Eve entered. Bob finding the body after seeing Diana come from medbay direction is important, but Diana also says Frank came out of medbay direction right before the report. So for me the main people with opportunity are Diana, Frank, and maybe Alice depending on her path.

I want to hear Alice’s exact route, especially whether she saw Eve or Frank around medbay/electrical. Right now I’m most suspicious of whoever was last coming out of medbay before Bob found the body, but I don’t think my info hard-clears anyone.

My route was storage -> medbay -> electrical. I was in medbay with Diana around ticks 3-5, and there was no body there while I was there. I did not see Eve at all this round.

At tick 6, I saw Frank enter medbay from upper engine while I was leaving toward electrical. After that I stayed in electrical doing my task until the meeting. So if Frank is saying Eve entered medbay right after I left, then by his own info he was in/near medbay with Eve alive after I was gone.

Diana was with me earlier, and Bob says he saw her in storage around tick 7, so she did come from that direction, but Diana also says Frank came into storage from the medbay direction later, right before the report. That makes Frank the most suspicious to me: he was the one who saw Eve alive in medbay, then was later seen leaving that area. I think the strongest vote is Frank unless someone has a better reason.

Yeah, after hearing everyone, I think this points most strongly to Frank.

My hard info is still: I came navigation -> storage -> medbay. I saw Diana enter storage from the medbay direction at tick 7, then I went into medbay and found Eve’s body. So initially Diana looked suspicious to me.

But Frank’s own story says Eve was alive entering medbay after Alice left, and Diana says she later saw Frank come into storage from the medbay direction right before the report. Alice also confirms Frank entered medbay around tick 6 while she left. That puts Frank as the last clearly known person with Eve alive in medbay, then seen leaving that area.

Diana being in storage before I went to medbay makes her less likely unless she doubled back, and nobody has said that. I think Frank has the strongest opportunity here.

I get why it looks bad from the timing, but the key point is I did not stay in medbay with Eve. I came down from upper engine, saw Alice leaving toward electrical and Eve coming in from electrical basically right after, and I kept moving through. I didn’t find or see a body.

Diana is being treated as “less likely” because she was in storage, but Bob’s original info was literally that Diana came into storage from the medbay direction right before he found the body. That is exactly the same accusation being put on me, except she was there first. If Eve died right after entering medbay, Diana had just been in that area and left toward storage.

Also, Alice and Diana are both confirming each other for being in medbay earlier, but neither saw Eve — which means Eve entered after that group split. The people closest to that timing are still Diana and me, and Bob’s first instinct was Diana for a reason.

I’m not asking you to hard-clear me, but voting me just because I saw Eve alive is weak. Ducks often say “last seen with” to frame someone. I think Diana’s path from medbay into storage right before the report is the more suspicious one.

I want to clarify the timing because Frank is trying to make my path sound the same as his, but it isn’t.

I left medbay before Bob went in. Bob saw me in storage around tick 7, and then Bob left storage into medbay and found the body. I did not double back into medbay. My route stayed electrical -> medbay -> storage.

Frank, though, was confirmed entering medbay around tick 6 by Alice, says he saw Eve alive entering medbay, and then I personally saw Frank come into storage from the medbay direction at tick 9, right before/around the report. So he is the one who was most recently coming out of the body area after Eve was alive.

Alice and I can confirm medbay was clear earlier. The kill had to happen after Eve entered, and Frank is the only person placing himself there with Eve alive after Alice and I left. I’m still most suspicious of Frank here.

My only direct info is still that I saw Frank in oxygen around tick 3, so I can confirm he started north. But that does not clear him, because the route to medbay by tick 6-ish is possible.

After hearing everyone, I think the strongest logic is on Frank. Alice confirms Frank entered medbay as she left, Frank himself says Eve entered medbay alive right after, and Diana says Frank later came out from the medbay direction into storage right before the report. That makes Frank the last clearly placed person with Eve alive and then leaving the body area.

Diana looked suspicious from Bob’s first report, but the timing makes her seem earlier than Frank, and if Eve was alive after Alice left, that points more toward Frank’s window. I’m leaning Frank here.

I’ll restate my info clearly: I went storage -> medbay -> electrical. I was in medbay with Diana around ticks 3-5, and medbay was clear then. I never saw Eve at all.

At tick 6, I saw Frank enter medbay from upper engine right as I was leaving toward electrical. After that, I stayed in electrical doing my task until the meeting was called.

So the important part is: Diana and I were in medbay earlier with no body. Then I leave, Frank enters, and Frank himself says Eve came into medbay alive right after that. Later, Diana says she saw Frank come into storage from the medbay direction near the report timing. That makes Frank the last person clearly with Eve alive and then seen leaving that area.

I think Diana looked suspicious at first because she came from medbay direction too, but the timing from everyone’s stories points more strongly to Frank. I’m voting Frank.
